title: Committed on Main
description: An authentication feature was committed directly on main by mistake.
mission: Move the authentication commit onto a feature/* branch and restore main to its original commit. Keep the feature change in Git history.
success: main is restored and the change is safely reachable from a feature branch.
hints: Inspect the graph and branch pointers with git log and git branch.
Create the feature branch while the mistaken commit is still checked out.
After preserving the commit on feature/auth, switch to main and move main back one commit.
